description: List item sourcing profiles — the stored link between an item and its default price book + production spec — including live drift status: specValid=false means the spec no longer matches the book's current schema and quoting is blocked until an operator re-reviews; schemaStale=true means the schema changed since authoring (re-review recommended). Optionally narrowed to one item by SKU. Paged: pass limit (1–100) with offset; omit limit for every row up to 100, or PAGING_REQUIRED. While hasMore is true, call again with offset=nextOffset.

itemSku.description: Optional item SKU — narrows the list to that item's profiles.

limit.description: Page size (1–100). Omit for every row up to 100, else PAGING_REQUIRED.

offset.description: Zero-based row offset; requires limit when nonzero.

name: list_item_sourcing_profiles
title: List Item Sourcing Profiles
